advisory_context_builder_architecture: build_advisory_context(snapshot_path, request) is the single pipeline entry point: validate AdvisoryContextRequest, translate to existing QueryRequest, invoke execute_query (Track 121, unmodified), defensively validate the QueryResult shape, select records with an optional deterministic max_records bound, verify attribution presence for content-bearing categories, verify boundary disclosure presence, and assemble a RepositoryIntelligenceContextPackage. Every fail-closed condition raises AdvisoryContextBuilderError.
attribution_verification: Verified. attribution_bundle is the Query Result's own attribution carried forward unchanged. ensure_attribution_present fails closed if any content-bearing category (entity/capability/architectural_contract/attribution lookup) selects records without attribution; limitation_lookup and boundary_lookup are exempted, mirroring the Query Layer's own exemption. Confirmed via test_entity_context_preserves_attribution_limitations_and_boundaries and test_missing_attribution_on_content_record_fails_closed.

context_package_description: RepositoryIntelligenceContextPackage: selected_repository_intelligence, attribution_bundle, limitation_bundle, boundary_disclosure_bundle (boundary_disclosures, disclaimers, non_authority_disclaimer), context_metadata (advisory_purpose, query_request, source_artifact, result_status, unknowns, record_count, assembly_timestamp). Structurally independent from the frozen 115W AdvisoryContextPackage; no section placement decided.
determinism_verification: Verified. Identical Query Layer results plus identical advisory context request produce an equivalent logical context package. Record selection is a deterministic prefix of the Query Layer's own already-sorted records; attribution/limitation ordering is inherited unchanged; JSON serialization uses sorted keys. assembly_timestamp is a declared wall-clock value explicitly excluded from the logical-equality guarantee (122B S14 'logically identical', not byte-identical). Confirmed via test_repeated_context_assembly_is_deterministic (10+ repeated calls compared with assembly_timestamp excluded) and test_serialize_context_package_is_deterministic_json.
